mapper.sql: p.id AS passId, CONCAT('PASS-', LPAD(p.id, 8, '0')) AS passNumber, u.name_enc AS customerNameEnc, u.phone_enc AS customerPhoneEnc, p.expires_at AS expiresAt, p.total_credits AS totalCredits, p.remaining_credits AS remainingCredits, p.total_price AS totalPrice, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings b JOIN slots s ON s.id = b.slot_id WHERE b.pass_purchase_id = p.id AND b.status = 'BOOKED' AND s.start_at > #{now} ) AS futureBookingCount, r.amount AS refundAmount, r.status AS refundStatus

SELECT
FROM pass_purchases p JOIN ( SELECT p.id FROM pass_purchases p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id
ORDER BY p.purchased_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset} ) selected ON selected.id = p.id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.id = ( SELECT MAX(latest_refund.id) FROM refunds latest_refund WHERE latest_refund.pass_purchase_id = p.id ) ORDER BY p.purchased_at DESC, p.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pass_purchases p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id

FROM pass_purchases p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.id = ( SELECT MAX(latest_refund.id) FROM refunds latest_refund WHERE latest_refund.pass_purchase_id = p.id ) WHERE p.id = #{passId}
